SPTR(:) is an eligible array pointer; its declaration does not establish association or make an unassociated pointer a valid IS_CONTIGUOUS argument.

requirements.title: CONTIGUOUS has three eligible entity categories
requirements.definition: An entity with CONTIGUOUS is an array pointer, an assumed-shape array or an assumed-rank dummy data object. An object being actually contiguous does not by itself make it eligible for the attribute. The assumed-rank category can have a scalar effective argument; an ordinary fixed-rank scalar pointer is not that category.
requirements.oracle: Fourteen complete compile/f2023 program units represent eight C830 facets. Five negatives give CONTIGUOUS to an ordinary scalar, scalar pointer, ordinary explicit-shape array, fixed-rank deferred-shape ALLOCATABLE array, or nonpointer assumed-size dummy. Each control deletes only ', contiguous', preserving every other byte and the actual entity category. Four additional admissions declare an array pointer and explicit-interface assumed-shape, ordinary assumed-rank and ALLOCATABLE assumed-rank dummies. A negative needs the actual located CONTIGUOUS/entity-category cause in the actual staged input, matching one complete extracted diagnostic message. The four ordinary declarations retain their line3 anchor. The assumed-size dummy has primary declaration line6 and additional procedure-header line4 as separate subject anchors; gap line5 and cross-anchor ranges do not qualify. An ordinary zero or nonzero reporting status can satisfy that capability. Only the exact observed Flang portability message is an allowed nonfatal report. Every valid case requires successful object compilation and is positive-control evidence, not a runtime effect.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The assumed-size pair preserves the original complete module/procedure source and its CONTIGUOUS-only repair. Its declaration/header relation uses the independently reviewed disjoint-anchor infrastructure from batch048, not a broadened span, coalesced statements or a false GNU conformance failure for selecting the header. Source, fixture and processor adjudications remain separate from representing that relation. This finite eligibility matrix is not an enumeration of all possible declarations, actual arguments or processor modes. Ordinary fixed-rank exclusions do not ban eligible assumed-rank dummies, and actual whole-array contiguity does not authorize the attribute. Module-contained procedures supply explicit interfaces without requiring any unavailable payload, allocation or pointer-association inquiry. No initializer, DATA, SAVE, coarray, C companion, user-defined type, argument call, pointer assignment or runtime observer is present. All four S-owned contiguity requirements, residual processor choices and canonical component/source-use owners remain separate. No fatal exit, printed rule code or prescribed English text is required. Exact finite message alternatives are qualification predicates, not standardized wording. Quoted examples inside another error and foreign paths sharing the source basename cannot supply this cause or source identity. Source echoes, bare attribute words, unrelated shape/type/kind failures, unsupported facilities, Internal/ASR/verifier, timeout/crash/resource failures and wrong-source reports do not count. Generation preserves independent source, case, link, SourceUses and inventory adjudications; it neither approves them nor relabels earlier compiler observations.

requirements.title: Eligible CONTIGUOUS dummies have a contiguous view
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p1 assumed-shape and assumed-rank clauses, physical PDF123, lines18-19
requirements.definition: The CONTIGUOUS attribute makes an assumed-shape array or assumed-rank dummy data object contiguous. A permitted actual argument need not itself be contiguous. The source defines the dummy's property, not a particular copying, allocation, address or optimization mechanism.

requirements.title: A CONTIGUOUS array pointer is associated only with a contiguous target
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p1 pointer clause, physical PDF123, lines18-19
requirements.definition: When an array pointer has CONTIGUOUS, a target with which it is pointer associated is contiguous. The attribute does not establish association, require an associated target at all times, or make arbitrary targets contiguous. Ordinary pointer assignment requires actual contiguity here; the stronger simply-contiguous conditions in other contexts retain their own owners.

pending.whole-target-admission: PENDING a live defined INTEGER TARGET array and a CONTIGUOUS pointer associated with the whole compatible array. Check association state before IS_CONTIGUOUS/value use, and retain type/kind/rank/parameter and lifetime premises. No address comparison or initial association is inferred from the pointer declaration.

Its explicit stride prevents simply-contiguous syntax under9.5.4 even though actual contiguity is guaranteed. Keep this distinct from pointer-dummy argument and bounds-remapping restrictions; no vector target.

Do not instantiate a rejection case unless a separate, explicit diagnostic policy is approved; without it retain only the source relation. No policy is authored here. Do not execute the nonconforming assignment, demand a runtime trap, or invent mandatory prose diagnostics.

A correct CONTIGUOUS pointer-dummy actual needs the exact9.5.4/C1550 premise and full association rules. Adding CONTIGUOUS to that actual is a candidate repair only when its existing target is genuinely contiguous; rank-one bounds-remapping permission does not waive pointer-target contiguity.

requirements.title: The seven stated routes guarantee actual contiguity
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p2 and list, physical PDF123, lines20-38
requirements.definition: Contiguity is guaranteed for an object with CONTIGUOUS; a nonpointer whole array that is not assumed-shape; an assumed-shape array associated with a contiguous actual; an assumed-rank dummy with a contiguous effective argument; an array allocated by an ALLOCATE statement; or a pointer associated with a contiguous target. A nonzero-size array section is also contiguous when its base is contiguous, it has no vector subscript, selected elements retain base array-element order with no interleaved excluded elements, any CHARACTER substring includes the whole parent string, only the final part-ref has nonzero rank, and it is not an array complex-part designator.

pending.attributed-object: PENDING valid CONTIGUOUS array-pointer and assumed-shape/rank dummy contexts, with every required pointer association established before inquiry. Reuse the p1 contexts where source ownership/evidence permits; no attribute-only no-op or unassociated-pointer query.
pending.whole-nonpointer-array: PENDING ordinary explicit-shape arrays including a zero-size whole array, and a named ALLOCATABLE whole array in both unallocated and allocated states.16.1 and16.9.115 permit the nonpointer unallocated property inquiry; expect true via the whole-array route but never inquire its unavailable bounds/shape or read payload. Treat assumed-shape/rank dummies through their actual stated premises, not a blanket whole-name shortcut.
pending.assumed-shape-contiguous-actual: PENDING explicit-interface assumed-shape dummy without a CONTIGUOUS declaration, associated with a defined ordinary contiguous whole-array actual. Directly inquire the dummy and expect true. A noncontiguous actual without the attribute is not assigned a false oracle merely by failing this positive route; temporary/other-object semantics must be checked.
pending.assumed-rank-contiguous-effective: PENDING an assumed-rank dummy without relying on a CONTIGUOUS declaration, with a genuine contiguous array effective argument and a valid explicit interface. Expect true from the actual dummy's property. Rank-zero returns have a separate intrinsic disjunct and are not proof of this array-contiguity premise.
pending.allocated-array: PENDING successful ALLOCATE statements for an ordinary allocatable array and an array pointer target, with nonzero and zero-size variants. Check status/ALLOCATED or defined pointer association first; use one-argument association status for zero-size pointer targets. Expect contiguity without querying or reading unavailable data, and do not infer allocator layout or generalize this route to allocation events from other clauses.
pending.associated-pointer: PENDING pointer without CONTIGUOUS associated to a live contiguous TARGET whole array, followed by IS_CONTIGUOUS true and separately defined value checks. This does not give the pointer a CONTIGUOUS attribute or make its object-name simply contiguous.
pending.gap-free-numeric-section: PENDING nonzero contiguous INTEGER sections such as a(2:3) of a(4), with known bounds and each p2(7) predicate explicitly established. Direct inquiry expects true; a delegated dummy that may receive another view is not substituted for the actual section under test.
pending.full-leading-dimensions: PENDING parent a(2,3) with section a(1:2,1:2), and a(:,2), checking original array-element order and no gaps. The former is actually contiguous while its explicit nonfinal triplet is not the simple ':' syntax. Contrast only through source-qualified canonical9.5.4 rules, not a unit-stride heuristic.
pending.stride-and-singleton-boundary: PENDING a(1:4:1) of a(4) and singleton a(2:2:7), each nonzero-size and satisfying the full positive conjunction. Both are actually contiguous; an explicit stride is nevertheless excluded by the simply-contiguous triplet syntax. Empty sections and unresolved singleton/vector/substring forms stay under p4 unless another normative route resolves them.
pending.full-character-substring: PENDING a defined default-CHARACTER array of length4 with a full parent-string range, such as whole nonzero section with(1:4). Check all other section premises and expect true. The presence of a substring-range prevents the corresponding9.5.4 simple-section form; do not infer a byte width or apply the same oracle to partial substrings.
pending.vector-and-multiple-subscript-source-use: PENDING exact R925 vector-subscript versus R920/R923 multiple-subscript/triplet expansion. A vector fails the positive section route, not automatically the whole contiguity decision. Consecutive-vector and expanded-triplet cases require their own full p2/p3 classification; no parenthesis/bracket or array-value proxy.
pending.ranked-part-and-complex-source-use: PENDING whole nonpointer array-component classification under9.5.2 separately from sections of scalar-parent components, earlier-ranked array-of-structure selections and complex%RE/%IM arrays. For a section, prove base contiguity and every ordering/ranked-part predicate; do not turn failure of p2(f)/(g) into an automatic false result or infer padding.

requirements.oracle: Direct IS_CONTIGUOUS on eligible actual objects, with positive booleans justified by a specific complete source route. Independent known bounds/element positions and defined value checks support the chosen finite contexts; no address/stride/size formula is treated as a universal contiguity oracle.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A pointer argument must be associated; an ordinary scalar is not an eligible direct ARRAY argument, whereas an assumed-rank scalar is. Nonpointer unallocated property inquiries permitted by the actual intrinsic do not permit unallocated data reads. No missing positive premise is silently interpreted as noncontiguity; p3/p4 and the simply-contiguous syntax remain separate.

requirements.title: The stated array-subobject conjunction guarantees noncontiguity
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p3 and bullets, physical PDF123, lines39-44
requirements.definition: An array subobject is not contiguous when it has at least two elements, those elements in array-element order are not consecutive among the base object's elements, it is not zero-length CHARACTER, and it is not of a derived type whose only ultimate components are zero-size arrays or zero-length characters. All predicates are required. This is a valid-object property, not a language prohibition on noncontiguous arrays.

pending.ordinary-gapped-section: PENDING direct inquiry on a defined ordinary INTEGER a(1:4:2) with two separated base elements, expecting false. A complete derived type with a nonzero INTEGER ultimate component can supply a separate whole-element gapped case. No illegal CONTIGUOUS pointer association is executed as a negative twin.
pending.multidimensional-interleaving: PENDING a(1:2,1:2) of a known INTEGER parent a(3,3), whose selected positions1,2,4,5 contain a gap in base element order. Expect false from the original element-order relation; do not reuse the a(2,3) positive case's result or a fixed dimension/stride formula.
pending.nonconsecutive-vector-gate: PENDING source-qualified direct array-subobject a([1,3]) inquiry, distinguishing the vector-designated object from an ordinary procedure dummy/temporary view. Establish all p3 predicates and exact intrinsic actual-argument semantics before fixing the executable oracle; never infer every vector-subscripted section is false merely because p2 excludes vectors.
pending.cardinality-boundaries: PENDING finite zero-, one- and two-element section source map. The two-or-more premise excludes zero/singleton from this negative route; singleton sections may satisfy the positive p2 route, while other cases can remain processor dependent. Do not impose a universal size<=1, abs(stride)==1 or empty-section Boolean rule.
pending.zero-storage-type-exceptions: PENDING exact zero-length CHARACTER and derived types whose only ultimate components are zero-size arrays/zero-length characters. Their gapped sections are excluded from this negative rule; that exclusion alone does not prove true. Whole-array or other positive routes remain separately applicable. No guessed byte size, padding or ABI layout.
pending.ordered-reversal-source-use: PENDING original9.5.3.3 element-order interpretation for reversed traversals and distinct scalar/triplet/multiple-subscript forms. Confirm ordered consecutiveness for each finite candidate before an oracle; no generic negative-stride or adjacent-address assertion.

requirements.oracle: A false IS_CONTIGUOUS expectation is attached only after the entire noncontiguity conjunction and inquiry eligibility are established for the actual object. Residual or unresolved classifications remain pending with processor/source qualifications, not guessed booleans.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No rejection policy, undefined target/value trap, hidden-copy assumption or performance/address measurement. Source p4 and informative notes do not create additional mandatory false or true cases. The current R402 SourceUses inventory provides no execution/facet credit for these plans and is not modified.
